metadata.title: Settings
metadata.description: Manage your Safirdex profile, account, and preferences.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Customize your public identity, privacy, and account preferences.

account.title: Account
account.description: This information comes from your Firebase account and is never exposed on your public profile.
account.emailHelp: Changing the email address requires reauthentication. This action is not offered until that secure flow is available.
account.dangerDescription: Deletion permanently removes your Firebase identity and all associated Safirdex data.
account.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. Your profiles, usernames, follows, activities, decks, collection, and images will be deleted.
account.deleteProviderUnsupported: Self-service deletion is not yet available for this sign-in method because its secure reauthentication flow is not supported.

deleteErrors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again and verify your password before retrying.
deleteErrors.APPLICATION_MAINTENANCE: Account deletion is temporarily paused during maintenance.
deleteErrors.RECENT_LOGIN_REQUIRED: A recent sign-in is required. Sign in again, then retry.
deleteErrors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The confirmation does not match your username.
deleteErrors.DELETE_FAILED: Deletion could not be completed. Your access remains active; try again later.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Adapt Safirdex's language and appearance to your needs.
preferences.languageDescription: Switching language keeps the current page and its parameters.
preferences.themeDescription: Choose a theme or automatically follow your device settings.
preferences.savedLocally: This preference is saved on this device.
preferences.cardEffectsBetaDescription: This feature is still being fine-tuned.
preferences.cardEffectsDescription: Animates the main card on hover with 3D tilt, moving highlights, and your chosen holographic finish.
preferences.cardEffectsHint: The effect appears when using a mouse or another precise pointer.
preferences.cardEffectStyleDescription: Choose the finish applied to cards while effects are enabled.

cosmos.label: Cosmos
cosmos.description: A deep sky filled with glints.

light.label: White light
light.description: A diagonal white highlight sweeping across the card.

preferences.cardEffectsFootnote: These settings are saved on this device. Your system's reduced-motion preference always takes priority.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your password and the session open on this device.
security.passwordDescription: Receive a secure link to choose a new password.
security.providerManaged: Your sign-in provider manages the password outside Safirdex.
security.resetSent: The password reset email has been sent.
security.resetFailed: The password reset email could not be sent right now.
security.sessionDescription: Close the Safirdex and Firebase sessions on this device.
